title: Average price paid by buyer origin (US state / foreign country), Title Guaranty buyer statistics

source.dataset: Title Guaranty of Hawaii - Buyer Statistics ("Where do buyers of Hawaii property come from?")

editions_used.2025H1: Q2 2025 (JAN-JUN 2025), PDFs dated 2025-08 (for like-for-like YTD comparison)

source.latest_edition_available: Q2 2026 (Jan-Jun 2026 YTD); PDFs created 2026-08-22, last modified 2026-08-31. No Q3 2026 edition on the site as of 2026-10-08.

method: Average price = dollar volume / count of sales for each origin (US state or foreign country) on each TG panel (Statewide, Oahu, Maui County, Kauai, Hawaii Island). 'Hawaii-resident' = TG's HI row. Counts are TG's published integers.

Dollar volumes are TG's rounded strings ('$273.3M', '$8.0B', '$37.0K'). Each is parsed back to a band of +/- half the last published digit (e.g. $8.0B -> $7.95B-$8.05B; $674.5M -> +/-$50K). avg_price_low/high = band / count.

Band refinement (only where it tightens and never contradicts the headline band; band_inconsistencies lists any conflict - none found): (a) each island's HI row is intersected with the sum of the district HI dollars (district HI counts add exactly to the island HI count); (b) each Statewide state/country whose listed island counts add exactly to the statewide count, and the Statewide total, are intersected with the sum of the island bands. avg_price is then the band midpoint / count, and the literal headline figure / count is kept as avg_price_from_headline_published_figure. Refined cells: Statewide HI and CA (2025FY), Hawaii Island HI and Maui County HI (2025FY), Oahu HI (2026H1, 2025H1), Statewide HI and total (2026H1, 2025H1).
Ratios to the Hawaii-resident average: point = avg / HI avg; bounds use the extreme band combinations.

Primary periods: 2025FY (Jan-Dec 2025, Q4 2025 edition) and 2026H1 (Jan-Jun 2026, Q2 2026 edition). 2025H1 (Q2 2025 edition) is included only as the like-for-like base for 2026H1 (yoy_2026H1_vs_2025H1); 2026H1 vs 2025FY is not like-for-like.
Rankings: states (HI included) ranked by average price among those with count >= 10, and by total dollars (all 10 listed states); adjacent pairs whose bands overlap are listed as not separable.
Flags: flag_n_lt10 (task threshold) and flag_n_lt20 (report-wide small-cell rule) on every cell.

Group averages: (a) listed_mainland_states_combined = sum of the 9 listed non-HI states; (b) all_other_us_buyers_implied / all_foreign_buyers_implied = intersection of: published integer dollar share +/-0.5pt x total band; total band minus HI band minus the other group; and the listed-cell sums; (c) all_non_hawaii_buyers_implied = (total band - HI band) intersected with (100 - HI dollar share +/-0.5pt) x total band, / (other-US + foreign count). Other-US and foreign counts are tg.json derived_counts (district foot rows). These are derived bounds, not published numbers.

statewide_residuals: for statewide top-10 states that are missing from some island top-10, statewide minus the listed island cells gives the count and dollar band on the islands where the state was not listed.
district_hawaii_resident_avg: tg.json carries only the HI row (count + dollars) of each district panel, so only Hawaii-resident averages are computable by district.
notes: TG publishes only the top 10 states by number of sales (HI is rank 1) and up to 5 foreign countries per panel; states/countries outside these lists are unknown. The 9 listed mainland states cover ~74-82% of other-US buyers on each panel (see coverage). Rankings are therefore 'among published states', and a high-priced state with few buyers may be absent.

Averages are arithmetic means of TG's own sale universe (TG does not document its method: whether origin is the buyer's mailing address, or which deed/transaction types and property types count). Means are pulled up by a few luxury sales and are not medians; they are not comparable to MLS median prices.

Rounding: TG dollar figures are rounded as published ('$273.3M', '$1.9B'). The $0.1B-rounded cells are imprecise per sale: Statewide CA 2025 '$1.9B' / 1,271 = $1.495M (band $1.456M-$1.534M) but its island cells sum to $1,896.4M -> $1.492M; Hawaii Island HI 2025 '$1.2B' / 2,467 = $486K headline vs $497K from the district sum ($1,226.6M); Maui HI 2025 '$1.0B' / 915 = $1.093M vs $1.103M from districts ($1,009.1M). Oahu HI 2025 '$8.0B' / 9,202 = $869K stays +/-$5.4K. District HI cells published as '$1.0B'-'$2.8B' (Oahu) carry bands up to +/-$59K per sale.

Small cells (n<10 flagged; n<20 also flagged): Oahu 2025FY: 0 of 10 state cells and 2 of 5 country cells n<10; Maui County 2025FY: 1 of 10 state cells and 4 of 5 country cells n<10; Kauai 2025FY: 2 of 10 state cells and 2 of 2 country cells n<10; Hawaii Island 2025FY: 0 of 10 state cells and 3 of 5 country cells n<10; Statewide 2025FY: 0 of 10 state cells and 2 of 5 country cells n<10; Oahu 2026H1: 0 of 10 state cells and 3 of 5 country cells n<10; Maui County 2026H1: 6 of 10 state cells and 2 of 2 country cells n<10; Kauai 2026H1: 7 of 10 state cells and 2 of 2 country cells n<10; Hawaii Island 2026H1: 0 of 10 state cells and 3 of 3 country cells n<10; Statewide 2026H1: 0 of 10 state cells and 2 of 5 country cells n<10. Outside Oahu/Statewide most country cells are 1-17 sales; treat such averages as anecdotes - one $8M sale sets the average.

Some foreign cells average under $50K (Hawaii Island 2025 New Zealand 2/$37.0K, Germany 1/$36.0K; Kauai 2025 and 2025H1 Canada 1/$51.1K): these are not whole-home purchases (likely fractional/timeshare/small-lot interests); TG does not say.

Year-over-year change in a mean mixes price and composition: e.g. Statewide NY 2026H1 average ($2.55M) is driven by Hawaii Island NY 13 sales / $69.0M; Maui County 2025H1 includes UT 3 sales / $36.1M; Kauai Jan-Jun 2025 had 489 sales vs 325 in Jan-Jun 2026 with Lihue falling from 170 to 66 (anomaly noted in tg.json).

Country labels as printed by TG ('Korea', 'England' vs 'United Kingdom', 'Cayman Islands', 'Cook Islands'). The Kauai 2025 foreign dollar share is published as 0% with 2 foreign buyers worth ~$2.15M (0.18% of $1.2B), consistent with rounding.
Aggregates only: no owner names, addresses or parcel ids are used or output.

listed_mainland_states_combined.method: sum of dollars / sum of counts over the 9 listed non-HI states

all_other_us_buyers_implied.method: other-US dollar volume bounded by (a) published integer dollar share +/-0.5pt x total band, (b) total band minus HI band minus foreign band, (c) >= sum of the 9 listed states; interval = intersection; mid = midpoint

unlisted_other_us_states_residual_implie.method: (all other-US implied dollar band - listed-state dollar band) / unlisted count; wide because it is a difference of rounded figures

all_foreign_buyers_implied.method: foreign dollar volume bounded by the published integer foreign dollar share +/-0.5pt x total band and by the listed-country dollars (lower bound; also upper bound when listed countries cover every foreign buyer)

all_non_hawaii_buyers_implied.method: (total band - HI band), intersected with (100 - HI dollar share +/-0.5pt) x total band, divided by other-US + foreign count
